title: Verb + -ing or to: remember, forget, stop, try
en:
Some verbs change their meaning:

remember / forget + to do — a thing you need to do (before): Remember to lock the door. I forgot to send the file. remember + -ing — a memory of the past: I remember meeting him in 2019.

stop + -ing — finish an activity: He stopped smoking. stop + to do — stop in order to do something: We stopped to have lunch.

try to do — make an effort: I'm trying to finish. try + -ing — do it as an experiment: Try restarting the computer.

No change: like, love, hate, start, begin, continue + -ing or to.
ru: remember/forget to do — не забыть сделать; remember doing — помнить, как делал. stop doing — перестать; stop to do — остановиться, чтобы. try to do — стараться; try doing — попробовать (как способ). like/start/begin — оба варианта без разницы.

boss.situation: Write 5 sentences about your work habits using remember, forget, stop and try — with both -ing and to.
samples: I always remember to save my files.
I remember making a big mistake in my first report.
Last week I forgot to call the supplier.
I stopped working late because I was always tired.
If Excel is slow, try closing other programs.

qs.exp: A thing you need to do → remember to do.

qs.q: I remember ___ him at the conference last year.
He stopped ___ two years ago. He feels much better now.
If the printer doesn't work, try ___ it off and on again.
“We stopped to have lunch” means we finished having lunch.
qs.exp: stop to do = stop in order to do it.

qs.q: “I forgot to send the email” means the email was not sent.
qs.exp: forget to do → you didn't do it.

qs.q: I'm trying ___ (finish) the report before five.

qs.exp: Need to do → forget to do.

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: i forgot to call the auditor

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: we stopped to buy some coffee
qs.exp: stop to do = in order to.

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
Correct the mistake: “Remember sending me the file tomorrow.”
a: Remember to send me the file tomorrow.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “He stopped to work at 6 and went home.”
a: He stopped working at 6 and went home.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “I tried call you but the line was busy.”
a: I tried to call you but the line was busy.
I tried to call you, but the line was busy.
Don't forget to close the door.
Do not forget to close the door.
Don't forget to lock the door.
He has stopped working at weekends.
He stopped working at the weekend.
